remaining: Every major workflow remains open. Partial protection integration does not prove complete Photoshop layer semantics or byte parity.

Independent Photoshop group/mask/type/shape, brush/eraser/high-depth and multiselection shortcut references remain incomplete; current tests cover native invariants and limited independent raster references.
Auto-nest flags persist, but artboard auto-nesting itself is unsupported. Little-endian TIFF opaque shmd and other unimplemented descriptors still reject explicitly.
Create-composite is protection-edit only; five other Adobe routes and full conformance remain unimplemented. Existing resource/format limits apply.

Editable .pcraft import is still unavailable. Continue with sparse-default/profile interpretation and a native editable adapter plus desktop/API/history/save integration, rejecting unsupported content explicitly.

Original Smart Objects,artboards,rich text,auxiliary channels,effects,Blend If,comps and timeline still need native editable workflows. Exact menus/preferences/output and physical Intel/macOS14 qualification remain open.

Smart Objects,artboards,rich text,auxiliary channels,effects,Blend If,comps,timeline and other source features need native editable workflows. Keeping their source JSON/payloads is not rendering or full semantic validation.

Reader is bounded to16MiB manifest,250000 JSON values,4096 layers,16384 surfaces,256MiB blob and512MiB logical payload totals. Existing ZIP/Zstd limits remain. Optional previews and unreferenced entries are not loaded; unknown version rejects. Larger/streamed migration remains open.

All Photoshop byte parity,menus/shortcuts/preferences,major workflows and live/supported-platform qualifications remain open. Continue major functions before optional minor functions and final details.

Decoder qualification is bounded:256MiB compressed/output/window limits;ZIP512MiB archive/aggregate and256MiB entry limits. Dictionaries,concatenated/skippable Zstd,ZIP64/encryption and unsupported container features reject explicitly. Larger/streamed workflows remain open.

All previous Photoshop requirements remain: exact output bytes,menus/shortcuts/preferences,major functions and supported-platform/live qualification. Source fixtures do not establish Photoshop parity.
Keep major functions first; defer optional minor functions and final details.
All major workflow gates remain open. Photoshop JPEG quantization, factory native dialogs/defaults,3–5 progressive scan schedule/selection, exact output bytes and live UI remain unqualified.
JPEG action input, other Adobe JPEG-output endpoints and their scan/optimized fields remain unimplemented. Do not confuse local named-quality mapping with proprietary Adobe encoder equivalence.

Continue D01/I04: PSD/PSB Maximize Compatibility and native save/export policy, original .pcraft migration, broader modes/formats, profiles and large-file qualification. TIFF descriptor/opaque records, Save Transparency/pyramids and preferences remain open.

Live Photoshop JPEG references now exist (five quality8 variants); broader live checks remain open. Synthetic/third-party codec checks do not establish Photoshop rendering or file bytes. Rosetta does not substitute for physical Intel/macOS14 runtime qualification.
Keep remaining major workflows first; minor functions and final details are deferred.
